8a3(mdo): bu dang /skye ba dang /'gag pa ni kun rdzob bo//dge ba dang mi dge ba'i 'bras bu med pa dang /skye ba med pa dang /'gag pa med pa de bzhin nyid kyi jo bo nyid de la ni kun nas nyon mongs pa dang /rnam par 
8a4(mdo): ba med de/de ni dbu ma'i chos rnams kyi sgrub pa lhur len pa'o//de la 'di skad ces bya ste/kun rdzob dang ni don dam ste//dbye ba gnyis su yang dag bshad//kun rdzob 'jig rten pa yi chos//don dam 'jig rten 
8a5(mdo): 'das pa'o//kun rdzob chos la zhugs pa yi//sems can nyon mongs dbang du 'gro//don dam yongs su ma shes pas//'khor bar yun ring 'khor bar 'gyur//kun rdzob 'jig rten chos rnams la//mi 
8a6(mdo): mkhas pa dag rtog par byed//kun tu rtog pa de yis ni//sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar 'gyur//ji ltar so so'i skye bo yi//byis pas grol lam mi shes pas/mi zad pa yi sdug bsngal dag/
8a7(mdo): mang po rjes su myong bar 'gyur/gang du srid pa 'gag 'gyur ba'i//don dam dag ni mi shes pas//skye ba dang ni 'gag 'gyur zhing //skye med 'gro dang 'ong bar 'gyur//'jig rten chos la gnas pa yi//
8a8(mdo): blun po 'khor lo bzhin du 'khor//sdug bsngal gnas can 'khor ba 'dir//yang dang yang du 'khor bar 'gyur//ji ltar nyi ma zla ba dag/slar yang 'ong zhing 'gro bar byed//de bzhin srid par 'pho ba na//slar 
8b1(mdo): yang 'ong zhing 'gro bar 'gyur//'khor ba thams cad mi rtag cing //mi brtan skad cig 'jig pa nyid//de bas don dam shes pa yis//kun rdzob bden pa'i gnas spong ngo //mtho ris gnas nas lha rnams dang //
8b2(mdo): dri za lha mi rnams kyang ni//kun la 'pho ba yod gyur pa//kun kyang kun rdzob 'bras bu yin//grub dang rigs 'dzin gnod sbyin dang //dri za dang ni lto 'phye rnams//slar yang dmyal bar 'gro 'gyur ba//kun kyang 
8b3(mdo): kun rdzob 'bras bu yin/gang zhig brtson drag lha rnams dang //yon tan 'byung gnas la gnas gang //mtho ris las 'pho ltung gyur pa//thams cad kun rdzob 'bras bu yin/brgya byin 'khor los sgyur nyid 
8b4(mdo): de//gang gis dam pa'i gnas thob nas//slar yang byol song skyes nas 'jug/thams cad kun rdzob 'bral bu yin//de bas mtho ris lta rnams kyi//bden pa bzang po kun spong la//byang chub sems ni 'od 
8b5(mdo): gsal ba//rnal 'byor pas ni rtag tu bsgom//dngos po med cing dmigs su med//thams cad stong pa gnas med pa//spros pa rnams las yang dag 'das//byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan nyid yin//
8b6(mdo): sra ba ma yin 'jam pa men//dro ba ma yin grang ba min//de ni reg min bzung bya min//byang chub sems kyi mtshan nyid yin//ring po ma yin thung ba min//zlum po ma yin gru gsum min//phra ba ma yin spom 
8b7(mdo): pa 'di min//byang chub sems gyi mtshan nyid yin//sgom pa rnams las rnam 'das shing //mu stegs rnams kyi spyod yul min//shes rab pha rol phyin sbyor ba//byang chub sems kyi mtshar nyid yin//
8b8(mdo): dpe med bsgom du med pa dang //mthong min gnas khyi mchog gyur la//rang bzhin gyis ni rnam dag pa//byang chub sems kyi mtshang nyid yin//thams cad lbu ba lta bu ste//chu bur lta bur snying po med//rtag bam 
9a1(mdo): @#//yin bdag med de//sgyu ma mig rgyu dag dang mtshungs//gong bu bzhin du bsdus gyur ba//spros pa rnams kyis yongs su gang //'dod chags zhe sdang la sogs stang //don sgyu 
9a2(mdo): mtshungs 'ba' shig yin//ji ltar nang na thig le ni//skad cig de la mi mthong ste//shes rab pha rol phyin mthong na//de bzhin blo ni 'dus ma byas//rtag tu rgod cing rtse ba dang //smra zhing glu dang rol 
9a3(mdo): mo dang //gzhi la sogs pa'i bden pa rnams//de dag thams cad rmi lam mtshungs//lus can kun gyis 'dus byas pa//'di kun rmi lam dang mtshungs la//rmi lam sems kyi kun rtog ste//
9a4(mdo): sems kyang nam mkha' lta bu yin//gang zhig chu la 'di rtag sgom pa//shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i tshul//gang zhig 'di ni rtag sgom pa//dngos po kun las rnam grol nas//go 'phang mchog ni 
9a5(mdo): thob par 'gyur//bla na med pa'i byang chub gang //sangs rgyas kun gyis rnam bsgoms pa//bsgoms dang bcas pas 'dzin na ni//theg chen 'bras bu 'thob par 'gyur//'phags pa bdag med 
9a6(mdo): pa dris pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs so////rgya gar gyi mkhan po ka ma la gub ta dang /zhu chen gyi lo ts+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab bo////'phags 
9a7(mdo): pa 'jig rten 'dzin gyis yongs su dris pa zhes bya ba'i mdo//dam po dang po//sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo//'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus cig na/
9a8(mdo): bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i kha ba bya kal nang ka'i gnas 'od ma'i tshal na/dge slong gi ba/'dun chen po dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs so//de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das 'khor mang po brgya stong snyed kyis/yongs 
9b1(mdo): su bskor ba la chos ston te/'khor de'i nang na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jig rten 'dzin ces bya ba'ang 'dus par gyur te/byang chub sems dpa' semasadapa' chen po rnams/tshad med pa'i 
9b2(mdo): yon tan gyis yongs su brgyan pas sems bskyed pa'i phyir/chos thams cad kyi nges pa'i don mthar phyin pa thams cad shes par bya ba'i phyir/tshad med pa'i sgron pas tshe da med pa'i rgyan yongs su rdzogs par 
9b3(mdo): 'gyur ba shin tu shes par bya ba'i phyir/tshang med pa'i chos rnams kyi nges pa'i mtshan nyid rtogs shing khong du chud par bya ba'i phyir/smon lam tshad med pas lhag pa'i bsam pa shin du rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir 
9b4(mdo): yongs su rdzogs par shes pa'i phyir/sbyin pa'i rgyan dang /nges pa'i rnam par dag pa'i phyir/tshul khrims kyi rgyan dang /bzod pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/mnyen cing des pa'i sems dang /rnam par 
9b5(mdo): dag par bya ba'i phyir/brtson 'grus dang /yongs su dag pa shes par bya ba'i phyir/bsam gtan dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khong du chud cing rtogs par bya ba dang /de dag la sogs pa yon tan tshad med pa'i 
9b6(mdo): phyir 'dug pa las langs nas/bla gos phyogs gcig tu byas te/bcom ldan 'das gang na bde logs su thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to//bcom ldan 'das bdag skye bo mang po 
9b7(mdo): la phan pa dang /bde ba'i slad du/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams sangs rgyas kyi gdung mi gcod par 'gyur ba dang /spyod lam kun du tshul khrims la ma chags shing /tshul khrims rnam 
9b8(mdo): par dag pa dang ldan pa dang /chos chen po la nan tan byed cing 'phags pa'i chos kyi spyod yul tshad med pa 'dzin pa la shin tu mkhas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi slad du bdag zhu ba zhu'o//bcom 
10a1(mdo): @#//ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag chos rnams kyi yang dag pa'i mtshan nyid la shin tu mkhas pa lags/ji ltar na chos rnams kyi mtshan nyid 
10a2(mdo): shin tu rnam par 'byed pa la mkhas pa lags/ji ltar ni dran pa'i mthu dang ldan pa lags/ji ltar na chosathams cad kyi rnam grangs rnam par 'byed pa la mkha pa'i shes rab dang ldan pa lags/ji 
10a3(mdo): ltar na lus 'di bor nas nam bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi bar tu rgyun mi 'chad pa'i dran pa dang ldan pa lags/de skad ces gsol ba dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' 
10a4(mdo): 'jig rten 'dzin la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to//legs so legs so//'jig rten 'dzin de ltar khyod kyis byang chub sems dpa'i sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi phyir/de bzhin gshegs pa la 
10a5(mdo): don de dag dris pa ni legs so//khyod skye bo mang po la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir/'jig rten la snying brtse ba'i phyir/lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten la phan pa dang bde ba'i don gyi phyir/gzhan yang da ltar gyi 
10a6(mdo): dus dang /ma 'ongs pa'i dus kyi byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa la 'od chen pos snang bar bya ba'i phyir dri ba dris pa'i bsod nams ni dpag tu med do//khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa la don 'di dag dris 
10a7(mdo): pa ni nges par sems can thams cad kyi the tshom yongs su gcad pa'i phyir/sems can thams cad 'od kyis snang bar bya ba dang /bsrung bar bya ba'i phyir/sems can dag la phan pa'i don bstan pa'i 
10a8(mdo): phyir/skye bo dag gi yang pa'i lam las bsgral bar bya ba'i phyir/skye bo mang po'i rten dang /gnas dang /mgon dang /skyabs bya ba'i phyir/ngan song gsum las gdon cing dbyung ba'i phyir/sems can 
10b1(mdo): dag bla na med pa'i lam la bzung pa'i phyir/skye bo mang po dag skye ba dang /rga ba dang /na ba dang /'chi ba dang /slos pa'i mya ngan dang /smre sngags 'dod pa dang /sdug bsngal ba dang /'khrug pa las rnam par 
10b2(mdo): grol ba'i phyir/sems can la bla na med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde ba sbyin pa'i phyir/phyi ma ma 'ongs pa'i dus na dam pa'i chos bsrung zhing bskyab pa'i phyir phyi ma ma 'ongs pa 'jigs pa'i dus ngan pa'i sems can 
10b3(mdo): dag skral ba'i phyir/de bzhin gshegs pa la dri bar sems pa legs so//de lta bas na 'jig rten 'dzin khyed legs par nyon la rab tu yid la zungs shig dang /rnam par phye ste bshad par bya'o//
10b4(mdo): bcom ldan 'das de ltar bgyi'o zhes gsol nas byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten 'dzin bcom ldan 'das la phyir nyan to//bcom ldan 'das kyis de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to//skyes bu dam 
10b5(mdo): pa de la 'di skad ces bya ste/phan pa'i don bzhi mthong ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams chos rnams kyi yang dag pa'i mtshan nyid la brtson zhing nan tan byed pa dang /chos rnams kyi mtshan 
10b6(mdo): nyid rnam par 'byed pa la shin tu mkhas par 'gyur ro//bzhi gang zhe na/dran pa yongs su rdzogs pa thob par bya ba dang /dran pa rgyun mi 'chad pa thob par bya ba dang /shin tu byang ba'i shes rab kyis gong 
10b7(mdo): nas gong du 'phar ba dang /rtag tu dran pa'i sems dang ldan pa ste/'jig rten 'dzin 'di dag ni don rnam pa bzhi mthong ba'i byang chub kyi sems dpa' sems dpa' ba rnams chos rnams kyi yang 
10b8(mdo): dag pa'i mtshan nyid la brtsod zhing nan tan byed pa dang/chos rnams kyi mtshan nyid rnam par 'byed pa la shan tu mkhas pa yin no//'jig rten 'dzin gzhan yang don bzhi mthong ba'i byang 
10b9(mdo): chub sems dpa' sems 
11a1(mdo): @#//dpa' chen po rnams chos rnams kyi yang dag pa'i mtshan nyid la brtson zhing nan tan byed pa dang /chos rnams kyi mtshan nyid rnam par 'byed pa la shin tu mkhas par 'gyur ro//
11a2(mdo): bzhi gang zhe na/chos rnams kyi nges pa'i don la shin tu shes par bya ba dang /chos rnams kyi don shin tu shes par bya ba dag chos rnams kyi rgyu dang /rkyen rnam pa sna tshogs shin tu shes par bya

11b1(mdo): rab thams cad la shin tu mkhas par bya ba'o//'jig rten 'dzin 'di dag ni don rnam pa bzhi mthong ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams chos rnams kyi yang dag pa'i mtshan nyid la

11b7(mdo): tshogs pa shin tu dag pa dang ldan pa dang /spyod pa'i nan tan phun sum tshogs pa rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa dang/ji mi snyam pa'i bzod pa'i yon tan la bde bar gnas pa dang /chos rnams yang dag pa'i mtshan

13a6(mdo): bzhi gang zhe na/dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsten pa dang /rtag tu chos zab mo la nan tan byed pa dang /rtag tu sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i gan du 'gro ba la dga' ba dang /gsol ba dang zhu 
13a7(mdo): ba la dga' zhing shes rab sgom pa la mos pa'o//'di dag ni chos rnam pa 'di bzhi dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dran pa'i mthar thub pa yin no//'jig rten 'dzin 
13a8(mdo): gzhan yang chos rnam pa bzhi dang ldan pa'i byang chu ba sems dpa' sems dpa'i chen po rnams chos thams cad kyi rnam grangs rnam par 'byed pa la mkhas shing shes rab la nan tan byed par 'gyur ro//
